channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Walmart's $65 million Bayamón Supercenter groundbreaking, with about 600 permanent jobs and an opening targeted for Q2 2028, is the clear win. It is the retailer's first new Puerto Rico store in over a decade, and it is also weighing three to four gas stations. Manufacturing PMI posted a fourth straight month of expansion, and LUMA is advancing DOE-funded grid upgrades. The main risks are energy: the Oversight Board's revocation of the $5.9 billion Power Expectations contract leaves near-term generation uncertain, the New Fortress Energy LNG payment dispute is delaying deliveries, and a 17% power-bill increase is coming. Bankruptcies are on pace for a seven-year high and new-vehicle sales are down 12.6% year to date.
